"A gallows frame looks over the red lake at Mitsero..."
"At night, a bat circles the lake..."
"In the late afternoon light, the sunset and the lake are one..."
"In the village there is a guest house..."
"The man with the army boots and the windbreaker is sitting on a rock..."
"The man with the army boots is walking out of the water, wet to his ribcage..."
"It has been raining so much that the lake has overflowed..."
"Two vultures are gliding and sailing beneath the clouds, wings held in V-shapes..."
"The red lake at Mitsero reflects a sunset, captures it, holds it, even when the sun has died..."
